name: Codex Node lead
normative-structure: The Codex Node lead answers for the demand Codex Node takes up from the work board: it assesses each taken demand in the terms of the faces Codex Node serves, turns what is Codex Node's work into work its own offices do, posts what another micro-enterprise does back on the board, and gives back what is not Codex Node's work with its reasons. It staffs nothing outside Codex Node, does not hand a thread to a chosen enterprise, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
